paramInformation.label: Venetian Mode: Turning Time
paramInformation.description: Time required for the slats to make a full turn (180°)

paramInformation.label: Venetian Mode: Restore Slats Position After Moving
Delay Next Movement
paramInformation.description: Minimum time between switching the motor off and on again

paramInformation.label: Delay Motor Stop
paramInformation.description: How long to wait before stopping the motor after reaching the end position

paramInformation.label: Exclusion From Switch
paramInformation.description: Allow exclusion with the switch inputs while the device is included

metadata.inclusion:
1. Press and hold the S button until the LED turns solid blue.
2. Release the button, then press and hold it again for more than 2 seconds until the blue LED starts blinking fast.
3. Release the S button.
4. The blue LED blinks while adding. The green LED blinks slowly when the device was added successfully.
metadata.exclusion:
1. Press and hold the S button until the LED turns solid blue.
2. Release the button, then press and hold it again for more than 2 seconds until the blue LED starts blinking fast.
3. Release the S button.
4. The blue LED blinks while removing. The blue LED blinks slowly when the device was removed successfully.
metadata.reset:
1. Press and hold the S button until the LED turns solid blue.
2. Press the S button repeatedly until the LED turns solid red.
3. Press and hold the S button for more than 2 seconds until the red LED starts blinking fast.
4. Release the S button.
5. The LED turns solid green for about 1 second, then the blue and red LEDs blink for about 2 seconds. The blue LED blinks slowly when the reset was successful.
